summary_rationale: McKesson Corporation operates the largest pharmaceutical distribution toll-road in North America, generating $403.43 billion in FY2026 GAAP revenue and $5.41 billion in Free Cash Flow within an entrenched three-player oligopoly (McKesson, Cencora, Cardinal Health) controlling over 90% of U.S. drug distribution. Its strategic pivot out of lower-margin European retail, the ongoing separation of Medical-Surgical Solutions (Wellverse, backed by a $1.25 billion Apollo minority stake), and aggressive expansion into higher-margin Oncology & Multispecialty (2.96% adjusted operating margin, up 53% YoY in FY2026) and Prescription Technology Solutions (19.45% adjusted operating margin) structurally elevate consolidated profit pools and capital efficiency. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unqualified PASS due to severe customer concentration (CVS Health at ~24% of FY2026 revenue, though recently extended through June 2032; top 10 customers at ~73%), $5.06 billion in remaining long-term opioid litigation liabilities, redeemable noncontrolling interests ($2.56 billion) tied to physician MSO acquisitions, and emerging policy/cybersecurity risks (IRA Part B, 340B rebate model, and the August 2026 cloud data exfiltration incident).
